decisions.reason: The hierarchical search plugin has not been visible since 2018, so its value is still unproven, but it is a cheap add-on to the platform and costs little to keep open, though it is the most likely candidate for pruning.
The GIS platform is the firm's flagship and strategic core, so it is a committed investment rather than a marginal option and dropping it is very unlikely.
Mobile field data capture fits the enterprise GIS offer and the demand for mobile workflows, and with little evidence of poor value its option is still worth holding.
The search extension sits close to the core offer and is cheap to maintain, and with no clear negative evidence it remains worth keeping, though it may overlap with B.
